ablations.name: fixed_interval_matched
ablations.note: scheduler replaced by a timer at an exactly matched call budget.

ablations.name: no_fast_tier
ablations.note: Removing the fast tier removes the scheduler's only input, so it necessarily degenerates to a timer. Identical to fixed_interval_matched by construction — which is itself the finding: without the fast tier there is no scheduler left to have.

ablations.name: oracle

definitions.t0: Frame timestamps are taken with time.perf_counter() at the instant OpenCV returns the frame — NOT true photon arrival. Sensor exposure and driver/USB transport add an unmeasured constant offset, so photon-to-answer latency reported here is a LOWER BOUND.
definitions.photon_to_first_token_ms: t(first generated token of the answer) - t0(frame that triggered the VLM call). Includes preprocessing, vision encoding, prefill and any IPC — never model-only time.
definitions.photon_to_answer_ms: t(final token of the answer) - t0(frame that triggered the VLM call). Same inclusions.
definitions.answer_staleness_ms: t(answer emitted) - t0(frame whose evidence backs that answer). For a cache hit this is the age of the cached scene evidence, not the age of the cache entry.
definitions.false_trigger_rate: Fraction of VLM invocations fired on frames externally labelled as carrying no semantic change. Requires ground-truth labels; null when the run has none.
definitions.accuracy_vs_oracle: Agreement with the per-frame oracle (VLM invoked on every frame) on the same query timeline. Null unless an oracle run was supplied.
definitions.percentiles: numpy.percentile with linear interpolation over the full population of the run (no warmup discarded unless the run config says so).
definitions.energy_j: Trapezoidal integration of NVML power samples over the measured window. 'marginal' subtracts the idle baseline measured before the workload started.
definitions.null_vs_zero: null means NOT MEASURED. 0 means measured and the value was zero. They are never interchangeable.

vram.note: NVML board-wide usage, includes other processes — not our allocation alone

phase6_replay.enforcement: Three gates: (1) the decoder never runs ahead of the replay clock, so future frames are absent rather than withheld; (2) frame_at() raises FutureFrameError on explicit forward access; (3) QueryTimeline.answer() refuses evidence timestamped after the query. wall_clock_audit.within_wall_clock must be true.
